what_it_does: Addresses a performance bottleneck in very large supercomputers at exascale (trillions of computations per second). When computers exchange large blocks of data simultaneously across all nodes (all-to-all communication), even with large messages the interconnect latency (time to send, not bandwidth) becomes the limiting factor. This paper optimizes this specific collective operation for exascale clusters using direct GPU memory access to avoid unnecessary data copying.
